title: Compressed tooltip summaries & legend micro-interactions for high-density time-series
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Time-series dashboards with many series and long time ranges cause dense legends and very long tooltips. This increases keyboard navigation friction, impairs screen-reader clarity, and causes rendering janks on lower-powered devices. Goal: design a compact, accessible tooltip + legend interaction system that optimizes for rendering cost and cognitive load while preserving discoverability of series details and on-hover actions.
acceptance_criteria: Compact tooltip summarizes top 3 series values at a hovered timestamp, with an affordance to expand the full list.
Legend supports three density modes (Expanded / Condensed / Minimal) selectable via toolbar and respects user prefers-reduced-motion and reduced-data settings.
Keyboard users can open/close tooltip summary with Enter/Space and navigate to expanded list with Arrow keys; focus management returns to chart point after close.
Tooltip initial render uses precomputed lightweight DOM with progressive hydration for expansion to avoid main-thread spikes.
Performance: chart page with 150 series maintains 60fps interaction on modern mobile midrange device in Condensed mode; time-to-first-tooltip < 80ms on desktop for typical dataset.
Automated a11y tests and manual screen reader walkthroughs verify meaningful announcement of compressed summary and explicit link to expanded details.
design_decisions: Adopt 'compressed summary' pattern: show top 3 items by absolute magnitude with a ‘+N more’ affordance; this prevents long scrolling and keeps initial paint lightweight.
Legend density modes are an opt-in toolbar control stored in user preferences (console settings) rather than per-chart prop to avoid accidental global inconsistencies.
Implement progressive tooltip hydration: initial lightweight HTML with data-* attributes and inline styles, full React render only when user expands or hovers for > 250ms.
Use semantic list structure (ul/li) for expanded tooltip and ARIA role="listbox" with labelledby pointing to timestamp header to improve SR navigation.
Color tokens: reuse chart-token palette and add a high-contrast fallback mapping for accessibility and print/PDF exports.
Motion: reduce animation duration and remove translate-heavy animations when prefers-reduced-motion is set.
implementation_notes: Frontend: chart-canvas continues to paint series; tooltip HTML overlay is kept shallow (max 8 elements) and created outside React root to minimize diff costs.
Runtime: add server-side computed summary endpoint (optional) for very wide-range queries to avoid client aggregation O(N) work on low-power clients.
Fallback: when JS disabled, show static timestamp summary injected by server with a minimal legend snapshot image.
Github PR template: link design tokens update and a small runtime toggle for progressive hydration; include perf benchmarks in PR description.
QA: create synthetic load test page with 50/150/300 series and toggle density modes for comparative metrics.
accessibility_considerations: Screen reader: On hover or keyboard focus announce 'Timestamp – X series summarized, press Enter to expand' to give context and actionability.
Color contrast: ensure top-3 highlight colors meet AA contrast over chart background; provide explicit outline/focus ring for keyboard users.
Keyboard flow: Tab lands on chart point, Enter opens compressed tooltip, ArrowDown moves into expanded list, Escape closes and returns focus to chart point.
Reduced motion & data: respect prefers-reduced-motion and a user 'low-data' preference to default to Minimal legend mode.
Testing: include NVDA/VoiceOver walkthroughs in checklist and update a11y docs with example keyboard transcript.
perf_metrics_target: Main-thread blocking during tooltip open: < 12ms median for Condensed mode
Frame rate: >= 55fps during pan/zoom on midrange mobile in Condensed mode with 150 series
Memory overhead: tooltip DOM adds < 200KB of live nodes in typical use
